name: headspace Work & Study
provider: headspace (funded by the Department of Social Services)
summary: Free career, study and job-application support for young people aged 15 to 25, by webchat, video or phone.
key: A free service for young people aged 15 to 25.
who: Young people aged 15 to 25 anywhere in Australia.
how: Register online and book a time with a specialist, or call 1800 810 794.
catches: Support covers career direction, planning study and course selection, and writing resumes and cover letters.

evidence.quote: A free service for young people aged 15 to 25.
Access support from anywhere in Australia, via webchat, video or phone.
headspace Work & Study is funded by the Australian Government Department of Social Services.
